premise: Bee carries yellow dust from flower to flower all summer; in autumn Flower's petals fall and her brown middle is full of seeds Bee helped to make.
inspiration: The Little Red Hen (folk), turned: the helper is not left out but thanked, and the harvest, a head full of seeds, is the proof of her work.
lesson: Small, busy work can make something wonderful.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that is how seeds begin

en-US.title: Bee Helps the Flower
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} All summer long, Bee buzzed from flower to flower. {sfx:buzz} Bzzz, bzzz. [curious] Why are your legs all yellow? asked Flower {flower:pulse}. Bee {bee:sparkle} looked down. It was fluffy yellow dust from all the flowers she had visited. {bee:face happy} It sticks to me, she said, and I carry it from flower to flower. Butterfly {butterfly:float loop 0.3} came to help. Bzzz, flutter, bzzz. {canvas:leaves 0.5 12s} Then autumn came, and Flower's petals began to fall, softly, one by one. {bee:face sad} [sad] Oh, Flower! said Bee. {flower:face happy} [softly] Don't worry, smiled Flower. I'm busy making something. Wait and see, rumbled the old tree {tree:wobble 0.4}. And when the last petal had gone, Flower's round brown middle {flower:glow} was full of seeds. Hundreds of them! {bee:face surprised} [gasps] You helped make those, Bee, said Flower. {bee:face happy} [happily] Every one is a new flower, waiting for spring. {bee:hearts}

es-ES.title: Abeja ayuda a la flor
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} Todo el verano, Abeja fue zumbando de flor en flor. {sfx:buzz} Bzzz, bzzz. [curious] ¿Por qué tienes las patas tan amarillas?, le preguntó Flor {flower:pulse}. Abeja {bee:sparkle} se miró. Era un polvito amarillo y suave de todas las flores que había visitado. {bee:face happy} Se me pega, dijo, y lo llevo de flor en flor. Mariposa {butterfly:float loop 0.3} vino a ayudar. Bzzz, fru-fru, bzzz. {canvas:leaves 0.5 12s} Luego llegó el otoño, y a Flor se le empezaron a caer los pétalos, suavecito, uno a uno. {bee:face sad} [sad] ¡Ay, Flor!, dijo Abeja. {flower:face happy} [softly] No te preocupes, sonrió Flor. Estoy haciendo algo. Espera y verás, dijo el viejo árbol {tree:wobble 0.4} con su voz grave. Y cuando se cayó el último pétalo, el centro redondo y marrón de Flor {flower:glow} estaba lleno de semillas. ¡Cientos! {bee:face surprised} [gasps] Tú me has ayudado a hacerlas, Abeja, dijo Flor. {bee:face happy} [happily] Cada una es una flor nueva, esperando a la primavera. {bee:hearts}
